newsitem.title: USA: NYC Muni Assistance Corp plans $579 mln refunding.
newsitem.headline: NYC Muni Assistance Corp plans $579 mln refunding.

text.p: The Municipal Assistance Corporation for the City of New York is planning a refunding issue totaling about $579 million through a negotiated offering senior managed by Morgan Stanely & Co, according to the deal's preliminary statement.
The issue, Series G, is expected to come to market in the next two weeks, depending on market conditions. The size of the issue may also change.

Proceeds from the sale will be used to refund prior to July 1 1997 "a significant portion of the outstanding Second Resolution bonds through the issuance of additional 1991 Resolution bonds," according to the POS.
